desc_zh: 收錄由大學以大學社會責任實踐（USR）計畫等名義推動、與在地社區或學校合作的藝術案例，再依大學分成下層系列。
desc_en: Cases run by universities under USR (University Social Responsibility) programmes and similar schemes, in partnership with local communities or schools, grouped below by university.
note_zh: 歸類依據：案例資料或編註明確寫到 USR。K63 是否屬北藝大 USR，目前只見校方同源頁，尚待確認，暫未納入。各案例仍須各自符合收錄標準；系列本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: the case data or editorial note explicitly mentions USR. Whether K63 belongs to TNUA’s USR is so far shown only by the university’s own pages and is unconfirmed, so it is left out for now. Each case must still meet the inclusion standard on its own; the series itself is not a source.

org_zh: 國立臺南藝術大學（各子計畫由不同系所與在地社區、學校合作）
org_en: National Tainan University of the Arts (sub-projects run by different departments with local communities and schools)
area_zh: 以臺南為主（官田、六甲、南瀛地區等）
area_en: Mainly Tainan (Guantian, Liujia, the Nanying area, etc.)
desc_zh: 收錄南藝大以「藝術進鄉」、USR 等框架推動、與在地社區或學校合作的藝術計畫。各案例保有獨立條目，並共同掛在此系列下，方便整體檢視南藝大的在地藝術實踐脈絡。
desc_en: Cases by TNNUA run under ‘art into the countryside’, USR and similar frameworks, in partnership with local communities or schools. Each keeps its own entry while sitting together under this series, so the whole thread of TNNUA’s local art practice can be seen at once.
note_zh: 每個成員案例須各自符合平台收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。
note_en: Each member case must meet the platform’s inclusion standard on its own and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry itself is not a source.

org_zh: 國立臺北藝術大學
org_en: Taipei National University of the Arts (TNUA)
desc_zh: 收錄案例資料明確寫到北藝大 USR 的藝術計畫。各案例保有獨立條目。
desc_en: Art projects whose case data explicitly mention TNUA’s USR. Each case keeps its own entry.
note_zh: 歸類依據：案例資料或編註明確寫到北藝大 USR。K63 暫未納入（尚待確認）；母條目本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: the case data or editorial note explicitly mentions TNUA’s USR. K63 is left out for now (unconfirmed); this series entry itself is not a source.

org_zh: 國立中山大學管理學院 USR 計畫團隊
org_en: National Sun Yat-sen University, College of Management USR team
desc_zh: 收錄國立中山大學 USR 團隊推動的藝術計畫。
desc_en: Art projects run by the USR team at National Sun Yat-sen University.
note_zh: 歸類依據：案例創作者欄明確寫到中山大學管理學院 USR 計畫團隊。母條目本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: the case’s creator field names the NSYSU College of Management USR team. This series entry itself is not a source.

org_zh: 大葉大學
org_en: Dayeh University
desc_zh: 收錄大葉大學 USR（USR Hub「傳統新生」等）推動的藝術計畫。
desc_en: Art projects run under Dayeh University’s USR (USR Hub, ‘Tradition Reborn’ and similar).
note_zh: 歸類依據：案例創作者欄與編註明確寫到大葉大學 USR。母條目本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: the case’s creator field and editorial note explicitly mention Dayeh University’s USR. This series entry itself is not a source.

org_zh: 國立臺灣海洋大學 USR 團隊
org_en: National Taiwan Ocean University USR team
desc_zh: 收錄國立臺灣海洋大學 USR 團隊推動的藝術計畫。
desc_en: Art projects run by the USR team at National Taiwan Ocean University.
note_zh: 歸類依據：案例創作者欄明確寫到國立臺灣海洋大學 USR 團隊。母條目本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: the case’s creator field names the NTOU USR team. This series entry itself is not a source.

desc_zh: 案例標題含「節」「祭」或「季」的案例，例如藝術節、藝術祭、藝術季、小戲節，以及藝術島。
desc_en: Cases whose title contains 節 (festival), 祭 (festival/ji) or 季 (season), such as arts festivals, arts seasons and small-theatre festivals, plus arts-island events.
note_zh: 歸類依據：案例標題出現「節」「祭」「季」，或為藝術島（K46 馬祖國際藝術島）。系列本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: the case title contains 節, 祭 or 季, or is an arts-island event (K46, Matsu International Art Island). The series itself is not a source.

desc_zh: 不屬於 USR、也不屬於藝術節／祭／季，且實踐時間以超過一年為主的計畫，包括持續多年者。
desc_en: Projects that are neither USR nor arts festivals and whose practice mainly runs longer than a year, including multi-year ones.
note_zh: 歸類依據：只收不屬於 USR、也不屬於藝術節／祭／季的案例，再依案例資料的年份判斷——寫有「起」「成立」、起訖相隔兩年以上，或經人工確認屬持續性實踐者。年份或期間不明者暫不歸類。與短期互斥。系列本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: only cases that are neither USR nor arts festivals, judged from the years in the case data — marked ‘from’ or ‘founded’, spanning two years or more, or confirmed by the user as an ongoing practice. Cases with unclear years or periods are left unclassified. Mutually exclusive with short-term. The series itself is not a source.

desc_zh: 不屬於 USR、也不屬於藝術節／祭／季，且實踐時間以短於一年為主的計畫，例如單一檔期的展覽或工作坊。
desc_en: Projects that are neither USR nor arts festivals and whose practice mainly runs less than a year, such as a single exhibition run or workshop.
note_zh: 歸類依據：只收不屬於 USR、也不屬於藝術節／祭／季的案例，再依案例資料的日期或年份判斷——期間或單一事件在一年之內。日期不明者暫不歸類。與長期互斥。系列本身不作為來源。
note_en: Basis: only cases that are neither USR nor arts festivals, judged from the dates or years in the case data — a period or single-year event within one year. Cases without clear dates are left unclassified. Mutually exclusive with long-term. The series itself is not a source.

zh: 福爾摩沙北海岸藝術季
org_zh: 交通部觀光署北海岸及觀音山國家風景區管理處主辦、朱銘美術館承辦／策展
org_en: Organised by the North Coast & Guanyinshan National Scenic Area Administration; produced and curated by the Juming Museum
area_zh: 北海岸（基隆、萬里、金山、石門、三芝、淡水等）
area_en: The North Coast (Keelung, Wanli, Jinshan, Shimen, Sanzhi, Tamsui, etc.)
desc_zh: 收錄歷屆「福爾摩沙北海岸藝術季」的屆次案例。此藝術季由交通部觀光署北觀處主辦、朱銘美術館承辦，每年一屆，以北海岸山海地景與地方文化為題，結合田野、在地參與與社區共創。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下，方便整體檢視。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Formosa North Coast Arts Festival'. Organised yearly by the Tourism Administration's North Coast office and produced by the Juming Museum, it takes the North Coast's mountain-and-sea landscape and local culture as its theme, combining fieldwork, local participation and community co-creation. Each edition is a case in its own right while sitting together under this series.
note_zh: 每個屆次案例須各自符合平台收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2024「濱線測繪」(k83)、2026「潮歌—光火共舞」(k84)。官網：https://www.northcoastartsfestival.com（官網每年多半只呈現當前屆次，往屆請以本平台各案例為準）。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the platform's inclusion standard on its own and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry itself is not a source. Currently includes 2024 'Walking the Shoreline' (k83) and 2026 'Song of the Tide' (k84).

org_zh: 臺南市政府（文化局）主辦；總策展人龔卓軍（國立臺南藝術大學）
org_en: Organised by the Tainan City Government (Cultural Affairs Bureau); chief curator Kung Cho-chun (Tainan National University of the Arts)
area_zh: 臺南曾文溪流域（麻豆總爺、官田、六甲、左鎮、楠西、曾文水庫至七股出海口等）
area_en: The Zengwen River basin, Tainan (Madou Zongye, Guantian, Liujia, Zuozhen, Nanxi, Zengwen Reservoir to the Qigu estuary, etc.)
desc_zh: 收錄台南「Mattauw 大地藝術季」的屆次案例。「Mattauw」是麻豆的古稱、源自西拉雅語。藝術季由臺南市政府主辦、龔卓軍擔任總策展人，以曾文溪流域為策展核心，強調長時間田野調查、地方參與與生態倡議，被視為台灣第一個以「單一河流全流域」為主角、以行動倡議為核心的大地藝術季。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下，方便整體檢視。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of Tainan's 'Mattauw Earth Art Festival'. 'Mattauw' is the old Siraya-derived name for Madou. Organised by the Tainan City Government and chief-curated by Kung Cho-chun, it curates around the Zengwen River basin, stressing long-term fieldwork, local participation and ecological advocacy, and is seen as Taiwan's first land-art festival to take a single river's whole basin as its subject with advocacy at its core. Each edition is a case in its own right while sitting together under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2022《曾文溪的一千個名字》(k47)、2026《曲流擺：曾文溪的裏淺山》(k32)。官網網址本次未確認，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard on its own and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry itself is not a source. Currently includes 2022 'A Thousand Names of the Zengwen River' (k47) and 2026 'Meander Sway' (k32). The official URL was not confirmed this time, to be added.

org_zh: 客家委員會主辦
org_en: Organised by the Hakka Affairs Council
area_zh: 台三線沿線客庄（桃園、新竹、苗栗、台中等 5 縣市）
area_en: Hakka villages along Provincial Highway 3 (Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Miaoli, Taichung and five counties in all)
desc_zh: 收錄客家委員會主辦「浪漫台三線藝術季」的屆次案例。藝術季沿台三線客庄舉辦，以客家生活美學為題，結合藝術策展、設計與飲食，強調在地參與與客庄文化再現。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the Hakka Affairs Council's 'Romantic Route 3 Arts Festival'. Held along the Hakka villages of Provincial Highway 3, it takes Hakka living aesthetics as its theme and combines art curation, design and food, stressing local participation and the re-presentation of Hakka village culture. Each edition is a case in its own right under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2019 首屆「有的是時間」(k22)、2023 第二屆「Falabidbog 花啦嗶啵」(k85)。官網網址本次未確認，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2019 first edition (k22) and the 2023 second edition (k85). Official URL not confirmed this time, to be added.

zh: 成龍濕地國際環境藝術節
en: Chenglong Wetlands International Environmental Art Festival
org_zh: 觀樹教育基金會（2010 起）／近年由成龍社區發展協會接續；林務局（農業部）支持
org_en: Kuan-Shu Educational Foundation (from 2010), later continued by the Chenglong Community Development Association; supported by the Forestry Bureau (Ministry of Agriculture)
area_zh: 雲林縣口湖鄉成龍濕地
desc_zh: 收錄雲林口湖「成龍濕地國際環境藝術節」的屆次案例。成龍濕地因地層下陷與海水倒灌而形成；藝術節自 2010 年起，邀國內外藝術家駐村、就地取材，與成龍國小師生及社區居民共創，喚起對濕地與人環境議題的關注。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Chenglong Wetlands International Environmental Art Festival' in Kouhu, Yunlin. The wetland formed through subsidence and seawater intrusion; since 2010 the festival has brought artists into residence to make site-sourced work with the local primary school and residents, raising attention to wetland-and-people environmental issues. Each edition is a case in its own right under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2010 首屆 (k86)、2017『愛行動·愛改變』(k87)、2022 回歸屆 (k88)、2025『土地親像花』(k23)。官網網址本次未確認，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2010 first edition (k86), 2017 (k87), the 2022 return (k88) and 2025 (k23). Official URL not confirmed this time.

org_zh: 臺東縣政府主辦
org_en: Organised by the Taitung County Government
area_zh: 臺東南迴沿線（大武、太麻里、金峰、達仁等）
area_en: Along the Nanhui route, Taitung (Dawu, Taimali, Jinfeng, Daren, etc.)
desc_zh: 收錄臺東縣政府主辦「南迴藝術季」的屆次案例。藝術季沿南迴公路山海地景，以駐村、現地創作串連部落與據點，深掘自然、生命與多元族群文化。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the Taitung County Government's 'Nanhui Arts Festival'. Along the mountain-and-sea landscape of the Nanhui Highway, it links communities and sites through residencies and on-site creation, exploring nature, life and the cultures of diverse peoples. Each edition is a case in its own right under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2022『藝術萌生地』(k89)、2024『光之迴境』(k90)、2025 正興部落《成為山的形狀》(k91)、2026『山徑之流』(k42)。官網網址本次未確認，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes 2022 (k89), 2024 (k90), 2025 (k91) and 2026 (k42). Official URL not confirmed this time.

org_zh: 鹿港囝仔文化事業（張敬業）、彰化縣保鹿運動協會（民間自籌）
org_en: Lukang Gina Cultural Enterprise (Chang Ching-yeh) and the Changhua Baolu Movement Association (self-funded)
area_zh: 彰化縣鹿港鎮（老屋、街區與在地店家）
area_en: Lukang, Changhua (old houses, streets and local shops)
desc_zh: 收錄「鹿港今秋藝術節」的屆次案例。這是返鄉青年張敬業帶領的鹿港囝仔與彰化縣保鹿運動協會自 2015 年起民間自籌的藝術節（首屆原名『鹿港藝術節：今秋會』），把展覽辦進老屋與店家、以街區策展與在地參與翻轉鹿港觀光印象。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Lukang Jinqiu (Autumn) Arts Festival'. A self-funded festival run since 2015 by the returnee-youth group Lukang Gina (led by Chang Ching-yeh) and the Changhua Baolu Movement Association (the first edition was 'Lukang Arts Festival: Jinqiu Hui'), holding exhibitions in old houses and shops and using neighbourhood curating and local participation to overturn tourist impressions of Lukang. Each edition is a case in its own right under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2015 首屆 (k92)、2019『移住今秋』(k53)、2022『洛津那夢』(k93)。約隔年舉辦；官網網址本次未確認，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard and have at least two independently read sources; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2015 first edition (k92), 2019 (k53) and 2022 (k93). Held roughly every other year; official URL not confirmed this time.

org_zh: 基隆市文化觀光局主辦
org_en: Organised by the Keelung City Dept. of Cultural Affairs and Tourism
area_zh: 基隆（正濱漁港、阿根納造船廠、基隆塔、信二防空洞等）
area_en: Keelung (Zhengbin Fishing Port, the Agenna Shipyard, Keelung Tower, the Xin-2 bomb shelter, etc.)
desc_zh: 收錄基隆市文化觀光局「基隆潮藝術」的屆次案例。這是全台最北的城市藝術季，自 2015 年起每年以正濱漁港一帶的山海城地景為舞台，用場域特定作品、走讀與社會參與連結港都記憶。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of 'Keelung Ciao' by the Keelung City Dept. of Cultural Affairs and Tourism. Taiwan's northernmost city art festival, held yearly since 2015 around Zhengbin Fishing Port, using site-specific works, walking tours and social participation to connect harbour memory. Each edition is a case in its own right under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2020 第 6 屆『海的一日』(k94)、2023 第 8 屆『海光介面』(k95)、2025 第 10 屆 (k80)。官網網址本次未確認，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2020 6th (k94), 2023 8th (k95) and 2025 10th (k80) editions.

org_zh: 連江縣政府與中華文化總會共同主辦
org_en: Co-organised by the Lienchiang County Government and the General Association of Chinese Culture
area_zh: 連江縣四鄉五島（南竿、北竿、東引、東莒、西莒）
area_en: The four townships and five islands of Lienchiang (Matsu)
desc_zh: 收錄「馬祖國際藝術島」的屆次案例。連江縣政府與中華文化總會以十年為期的大型藝術計畫，自 2022 年起把作品放進馬祖的戰地據點、聚落與海洋生活，以在地媒材轉譯軍事空間，處理戰地政務解除後的據點再生、常民記憶、閩東語復振與海洋環境。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。注意：《報導者》(2024) 的深度報導指出，不少居民把藝術島視為帶來遊客與收入的管道、對藝術本身較疏離，宣傳期過短使作品較不顯眼——收錄各屆時兩面並存，不簡化為『居民參與』。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Matsu International Art Island'. A ten-year plan by the Lienchiang County Government and the General Association of Chinese Culture, since 2022 placing works in Matsu's front-line sites, villages and ocean life, translating military space with local materials and addressing post-martial-law site reuse, everyday memory, Eastern-Min language revival and the marine environment. Each edition is a case under this series. Note: The Reporter (2024) found many residents see the art island mainly as a channel for visitors and income and feel distant from the art itself - kept alongside, not simplified into 'resident participation'.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2022 第 1 屆『島嶼釀』(k46)、2023 第 2 屆『生紅過夏』(k96)、2025 第 3 屆『拍楸』(k97)。官方藝術島網站本次未收錄連結，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2022 1st (k46), 2023 2nd (k96) and 2025 3rd (k97) editions.

en: Toucheng Old Street Culture & Arts Festival
org_zh: 金魚厝邊（彭仁鴻）策劃（民間自籌）
org_en: Curated by Goldfish Neighbour (Peng Jen-hung), self-funded
area_zh: 宜蘭縣頭城鎮（頭城老街、老鎮長故居）
area_en: Toucheng, Yilan (the old street and the former mayor's residence)
desc_zh: 收錄宜蘭「頭城老街文化藝術季」的屆次案例。頭城人彭仁鴻研究所畢業後返鄉，2014 年申請文化部青年村落計畫籌辦首屆、其後每年舉辦，並創辦『金魚厝邊』——把老鎮長故居改成青銀共創空間、邀老藝術家與老技藝者當主角講自己的故事、發行《青銀誌》。藝術季以老街與鐵道沿線為場域、連結移居者與在地居民。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of Yilan's 'Toucheng Old Street Culture & Arts Festival'. Toucheng native Peng Jen-hung returned home and, with a 2014 Ministry of Culture youth-village grant, ran the first edition and then held it yearly, founding 'Goldfish Neighbour' - turning the old mayor's residence into a youth-and-elder co-creation space, making elderly artists and craftspeople the protagonists of their own stories, and publishing a 'Youth-Elder Journal'. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2019 第 5 屆『移居。宜居』(k54)、第 9 屆『世界來作客』(k98，年份待確認)。首屆 2014、近年屆次年份來源較模糊，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2019 5th edition (k54) and the 9th edition (k98, year to be confirmed).

org_zh: 屏東縣政府主辦
org_en: Organised by the Pingtung County Government
area_zh: 屏東縣車城鄉海口港、看海美術館、恆春半島
area_en: Haikou Port and the Sea-View Art Museum, Checheng, Pingtung; the Hengchun Peninsula
desc_zh: 收錄屏東「落山風藝術季」的屆次案例。藝術季以恆春半島每年 10 月至隔年 4 月的季節性強風『落山風』為題，在車城海口港沙灘與看海美術館以風動裝置與地景作品，把在地人又愛又恨的強風轉成創作主角。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of Pingtung's 'Luoshanfeng Arts Festival'. Themed on the Hengchun Peninsula's seasonal strong wind (the luoshanfeng, Oct-Apr), it uses wind-driven installations and landscape works at Haikou Port beach and the Sea-View Art Museum, turning the wind locals love and hate into the protagonist. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2021『萬種風情』(k99)、2023『風的頻率』(k100)、2024（山內庸資）(k101)、2025『看！海口』(k56)。首屆約 2018/19、第 2 屆 2020 來源較簡，待補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes 2021 (k99), 2023 (k100), 2024 (k101) and 2025 (k56).

en: Palafang Hualien Jumping Waves Art Festival
org_zh: 花蓮縣文化局主辦
org_en: Organised by the Hualien County Cultural Affairs Bureau
area_zh: 花蓮（石雕博物館、花蓮美術館、文化局園區及市區衛星展點）
area_en: Hualien (Stone Sculpture Museum, Hualien Museum of Art, the bureau's park and city satellite venues)
desc_zh: 收錄花蓮縣文化局「PALAFANG 花蓮跳浪藝術節」的屆次案例。Palafang 是阿美族語『來做客、拜訪』，「跳浪」是地名也是東海岸的生活方式。藝術節 2021 年起以「花蓮當代藝術」為基調、「地方學」為策展核心，每屆由策展人 Nakaw Putun 等帶領，逐步建構花蓮當代藝術史脈絡。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Palafang Hualien Jumping Waves Art Festival' by the Hualien County Cultural Affairs Bureau. 'Palafang' is Amis for 'to visit'; 'Jumping Waves' is a place name and east-coast way of life. Since 2021 it has taken 'Hualien contemporary art' as its base and 'local studies' as its curatorial core, led by curators including Nakaw Putun. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準、各自具備至少兩個讀過的獨立來源；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2021 第 1 屆『後花蓮八景』(k102)、2022 第 2 屆『變化球』(k103)、2024 第 3 屆『星球爆裂』(k27)。查無 2023 屆報導（2021、2022 連辦，2024 重磅回歸），待確認是否停辦一年。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2021 1st (k102), 2022 2nd (k103) and 2024 3rd (k27) editions. No 2023 edition was found; whether it paused a year is to be confirmed.

org_zh: 臺南市政府文化局主辦；影響．新劇場（青少年扮戲計畫）；台積電文教基金會贊助
org_en: Organised by the Tainan City Cultural Affairs Bureau; Lab Theatre (Youth Theatre Project); supported by the TSMC Education and Culture Foundation
area_zh: 台南（臺南文化中心、台江文化中心、吳園公會堂、臺南市立圖書館新總館等）
area_en: Tainan (Tainan Cultural Center, Taijiang Cultural Center, Wuyuan Hall, the new main library, etc.)
desc_zh: 收錄臺南市政府文化局「十六歲正青春藝術節」的屆次案例。藝術節把府城『做十六歲』成年禮轉化為每年暑假的青少年藝術節，約 2015 年起辦（2017 年曾名『十六歲小戲節』）。核心「青少年扮戲計畫」由影響．新劇場藝術總監呂毅新規劃，每年徵選約 50 名 16–18 歲高中生，經半年三階段培訓後集體創作、公開售票演出一部原創劇作。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Sixteen Coming-of-Age Arts Festival' by the Tainan City Cultural Affairs Bureau. It turns the old city's 'doing sixteen' rite into an annual summer youth festival, held since c. 2015 (called the 'Sixteen Little Theatre Festival' in 2017). Its core Youth Theatre Project, led by Lab Theatre's Lu Yi-hsin, selects about 50 students aged 16-18 each year who, after half a year of training, collectively devise and ticket-perform an original play. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2023 第 9 屆《Detour》(k104)、2024 第 10 屆『築夢』·十週年 (k50)、2025 第 11 屆『Real Me』(k105)、2026 第 12 年『Touch』(k106)。其中 k104、k105、k106 來源較弱（主辦方或疑同新聞稿），標待查證，待每日擴充回補。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2023 9th (k104), 2024 10th / anniversary (k50), 2025 11th (k105) and 2026 12th-year (k106) editions; k104/k105/k106 have weaker sourcing and are marked to be verified.

org_zh: 苗栗縣傳統聚落文化協會主辦（發起人林光清）
org_en: Organised by the Miaoli County Traditional Settlement Culture Association (founder Lin Guang-qing)
area_zh: 苗栗縣頭份市蘆竹湳古厝聚落（約 50 座三合院）、通天宮
area_en: The Luzhunan old courtyard-house settlement (c. 50 sanheyuan) and Tongtian Temple, Toufen, Miaoli
desc_zh: 收錄苗栗頭份「蘆竹湳好采頭藝術祭」的屆次案例。蘆竹湳是頭份僅存的大型三合院聚落，因 1968 年工業區限建意外被保留。瓷林創辦人林光清 2014 年發起「蘆竹湳元宵好彩頭祭」，由苗栗縣傳統聚落文化協會每年以元宵乞龜、提蘿蔔燈遶境等民俗為核心，邀藝術家進駐老屋創作。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Luzhunan Haocaitou Arts Festival' in Toufen, Miaoli. Luzhunan is Toufen's only large surviving courtyard-house settlement, preserved by a 1968 industrial-zone building ban. Porcelain-brand founder Lin Guang-qing launched it in 2014; the settlement culture association holds it yearly on Lantern-Festival customs, with artists making work in the old houses. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2018 第 5 屆（李小平）(k62)、2020『初心』(k108)、2023 第 10 屆『團圓』(k107)。另 2024 第 11 屆有聯合報報導（『邁入第 11 年』、流程含台北藝術大學演出），單篇、偏活動預告，待補第二來源後另立。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2018 5th (k62), 2020 'Original Heart' (k108) and 2023 10th (k107) editions. A 2024 11th edition has one UDN report ('11th year', with a TNUA performance in the programme), promo-style and single-source, to be added once a second source is found.

zh: 雷公火小戲節（戲說雷公火）
en: Leigonghuo Little Theatre Festival ('The Tale of Leigonghuo')
org_zh: 電光社區居民自發演出、電光社區發展協會；國立臺北藝術大學藝術社會實踐暨推廣教育中心陪伴
org_en: Self-performed by Dianguang community residents and its development association; accompanied by TNUA's Center for Art and Social Practice
area_zh: 台東縣關山鎮電光部落（Kaadaadaan，約七成阿美族、兩成客家）稻田
area_en: The Kaadaadaan (Dianguang) tribe, Guanshan, Taitung (about 70% Amis, 20% Hakka), in the rice fields
desc_zh: 收錄台東關山電光部落「戲說雷公火」的屆次案例。部落以 1896 年先民用竹砲擊退清軍殘部的「雷公火之役」為集體記憶，2013 年起居民把故事搬上收割後的稻田梯田發展成戲，由村民、返鄉青年與學童自演，以阿美、河洛、客、華語交織、不打字幕，盼在孩子心中種下母語種子；近年擴大為「雷公火文化生活節」。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of 'The Tale of Leigonghuo' by the Dianguang tribe in Guanshan, Taitung. The tribe's collective memory is the 1896 Battle of Leigonghuo, when ancestors repelled remnant Qing troops with bamboo cannon; since 2013 residents have staged it in the harvested rice terraces, self-performed by villagers, returnee youth and children in interwoven Amis, Hoklo, Hakka and Mandarin without subtitles, to plant seeds of mother tongue - lately expanded into the 'Leigonghuo Culture & Life Festival'. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2013 戲劇版首演 (k109)、2023 第 11 屆 (k61)。中間各屆（如『辦了六年』約 2019）報導零散、年份不易對應屆次，待每日擴充逐步補齊。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2013 first drama staging (k109) and the 2023 11th edition (k61). Intermediate editions are scattered in coverage and hard to map to years, to be filled in over time.

org_zh: 國立中山大學藝術管理與創業研究所師生（指導：謝榮峯）
org_en: Students and faculty of the Institute of Arts Management and Entrepreneurship, NSYSU (advisor Xie Rong-feng)
area_zh: 高雄市旗津區中洲（中洲渡輪站、漁港、魚市場、葉氏宗祠、永洲大戲院）
area_en: Zhongzhou, Qijin, Kaohsiung (ferry pier, fishing port, fish market, Ye ancestral hall, Yongzhou Theatre)
desc_zh: 收錄中山大學藝管所在高雄旗津中洲辦理的「中洲津餘祭」屆次案例。藝術節結合 USR「城市是一座共事館」計畫，2021 年首辦，以諧音「金魚」串「看津娛、認津漁、撈津餘」，關注漁村的海廢、遷村與社區高齡化。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of the 'Zhongzhou Jin-Yu Festival' held by NSYSU's arts-management institute in Zhongzhou, Qijin, Kaohsiung. Linked to the USR project 'The City is a Co-working Museum', first held in 2021, it uses the homophone 'golden fish' and addresses the village's marine debris, relocation and ageing. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2021 首屆 (k07)、2.0（2024，高市文化局社造計畫）(k110)。這是學院 USR／社造型的小型社區藝術節。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2021 1st edition (k07) and the 2024 2.0 (k110). It is a small academic-USR / community-building festival.

zh: 潮芳苑｜看見灘地藝術季
en: Chao-Fangyuan: Seeing the Tidal Flats Arts Festival
org_zh: 芳苑鄉公所主辦；人劇團（團長蔡旻霓）承辦；海洋委員會補助
org_en: Organised by the Fangyuan Township Office; produced by Humanity Theater (director Cai Min-ni); funded by the Ocean Affairs Council
area_zh: 彰化縣芳苑鄉（芳苑國小、漁民廣場、潮間帶、紅樹林海空步道、普天宮）
area_en: Fangyuan, Changhua (primary school, fishermen's plaza, tidal flats, mangrove sky-walk, Putian Temple)
desc_zh: 收錄彰化芳苑「潮芳苑—看見灘地藝術季」的屆次案例。人劇團團長蔡旻霓 2021 年隨柯金源拍《海之岸》後愛上芳苑，2022 年提出《看見灘地》孵育計畫、2023 年成立社區劇場，帶老中青素人在潮間帶做戲。前身為 2023「芳苑，我們的故鄉」、2024「破豆藝術季／彰化劇場藝術節」，2025 年起正式以「潮芳苑—看見灘地藝術季」為名。各屆案例各自獨立收錄、共同掛在此系列下。
desc_en: Cases for the editions of Changhua's 'Chao-Fangyuan: Seeing the Tidal Flats Arts Festival'. Humanity Theater's Cai Min-ni fell for Fangyuan after surveying it for Ke Jin-yuan's 2021 documentary; she proposed the incubation plan in 2022 and founded a community theatre in 2023, making theatre with amateurs on the tidal flats. Its precursors were 2023 'Fangyuan, Our Home' and the 2024 'Bodou Arts Festival / Changhua Theatre Festival'; the official name has been used since 2025. Each edition is a case under this series.
note_zh: 每屆案例須各自符合收錄標準；母條目本身不作為來源。目前收錄 2025 第一屆 (k41)、2026 屆 (k111)。前身 2023『芳苑，我們的故鄉』與 2024『破豆藝術季』名稱不同，列為脈絡、暫不另立案例。
note_en: Each edition case must meet the inclusion standard; this series entry is not a source. Currently includes the 2025 1st edition (k41) and the 2026 edition (k111). The differently-named precursors (2023, 2024) are kept as context, not separate cases.
